name: @seeya-ai/app
description: Desktop interface for seeya (D-042): an embedded terminal (Electron + @xterm/xterm + node-pty) that shows the sessions this machine discovers and lets a person open the harness in a tab. Second composition root (D-043) — consumes @seeya-ai/engine in-process. V2-T5b: also resolves @seeya-ai/cli's own compiled bin entry point (never imports its source) to spawn the daemon worker as a detached child, the same subprocess @seeya-ai/cli's own `seeya daemon` launches for itself.
